title: Less drain while asleep
line: Lets the controller chip power down in sleep. Needs controller firmware 319+ (Ally X 313+); checked first.
symptom: The Ally loses more battery asleep than it needs to while MCU powersave is off.
why: Every ROG Ally controller MCU behind asus-armoury / asus-wmi mcu_powersave.
risk_note: With old controller (MCU) firmware the controller can stay dead after waking, so the fix refuses to install until the firmware is new enough (Ally 319, Ally X 313, as the kernel's hid-asus).

changes.detail: Turns MCU powersave on at every start.
Set to 1 at once; the old value is saved.

undo: Deletes the rule and writes the saved value back.
bazzite: Handled by Bazzite's own MCU workaround (shows as fixed by the system when on).

probe.what: Looks for another rule that sets mcu_powersave, or the value already being 1 without GameCove (Bazzite's own handling).

watch.note: The kernel driver that owns mcu_powersave: a default of on would retire the fix.
The older driver with the same switch and the MCU firmware minimums.
